app.name: BCentral
nav.label: Screens
topbar.clockUnconfirmed: Clock not confirmed — check it under Settings
topbar.notPersisted: Browser may clear this journal under storage pressure — set a journal folder
topbar.folderNeedsPermission: Journal folder needs permission — click to reconnect
topbar.folderError: Journal folder: {error} — check it under Settings
radio.title: Radio
radio.intro: The MeshCore companion radio this PC talks to the field through. Connect it over USB or Bluetooth; the contact list below is read from the radio itself.
radio.unsupported: This browser has neither Web Serial nor Web Bluetooth. Use Chrome or Edge on a laptop.
radio.blindHelp: Blind means the radio is connected but nothing has been heard from it for more than {minutes} minutes (Settings).
radio.connectFailed: Could not connect: {error}. Check the cable or the pairing and try again.
radio.self.title: This radio
radio.self.name: Name
radio.contacts.title: Contacts
radio.contacts.refreshFailed: Could not read the contact list: {error}. Try Refresh again, or reconnect the radio.
radio.contacts.empty: The radio has no contacts yet. A field radio appears here once this radio has heard it.
radio.contacts.name: Name
radio.log.title: Log
radio.log.empty: Nothing logged yet. Connect a radio above; every step is logged here.
topbar.noRadioApi: No radio in this browser — use Chrome or Edge
radio.noSerial: No USB here: this browser has no Web Serial. Chrome and Edge have it.
radio.noBluetooth: No Bluetooth here: this browser has no Web Bluetooth. Chrome and Edge have it.
radio.reason.gaveUp: gave up reconnecting after {minutes} min — use Reconnect
radio.clockDrift.ahead: The radio's clock was {elapsed} ahead of this PC's when it connected. The journal is stamped with the PC's clock.
radio.clockDrift.behind: The radio's clock was {elapsed} behind this PC's when it connected and has been set forward. The journal is stamped with the PC's clock.
language.label: Language
home.title: Home
home.intro: The staff's communication desk: messages to the field over the radio, and the journal of everything that happens.
home.start: Start under Journal: pick or create an incident, then send and receive. An operator taking over starts under Handover.
settings.title: Settings
settings.operatorNameHelp: Required. Written into every journal entry you record.
settings.operatorNameRequired: Enter an operator name before doing anything else.
settings.deviceIdHelp: Generated once in this browser and kept. Every journal entry made here carries it.
settings.hubUrlHelp: Where the journal is synced to when there is internet. Not used yet.
settings.hubUrlInvalid: Not a valid URL: it should start with https://. Leave it empty until there is a hub.
settings.blindAfterHelp: The radio is reported blind when nothing has been heard from it for this long.
settings.blindAfterInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes, at least 1.
settings.fontSizeHelp: Applies at once and is kept. Largest is for a screen read from a metre away.
settings.highContrastHelp: No greys and no tinted rows. Applies at once and is kept.
settings.styleguide: Style guide: every component, for review
styleguide.title: Style guide
styleguide.intro: Every component of the design language in every variant and state, the colour pairs with their contrast ratios, the type scale and the icons. For review; not a screen the staff use.
styleguide.interact: Hover and focus: move the pointer over a component, or Tab to it.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Nothing fires while you are typing in a field, except Ctrl+Enter and Esc.
shortcuts.newMessage: New message: the cursor goes to the message text
shortcuts.reply: Reply to the current incoming row
shortcuts.expandRow: Open or close the current row (recipients, history)
shortcuts.send: Send or record the form you are typing in
shortcuts.cancel: Cancel: close a row form, drop a reply link, close this overlay
settings.clockConfirm: The clock on this PC is correct
settings.clockHelp: Check the time above against a phone or a watch, then tick this. It holds until the app is closed. Every journal entry records whether the time was confirmed.
settings.clockTrust.unknown: Time not confirmed in this session.
settings.clockTrust.manual: Time confirmed by the operator in this session.
settings.clockTrust.ntp: Time checked against a trusted source in this session.
journal.title: Journal
journal.exportedToFolder: Exported {filename}, also to the journal folder
journal.exportFailed: Export failed: {error}. The journal is unchanged; try again.
journal.loadFailed: Could not read the journal: {error}. Reload the page; if it persists, the journal folder and the last export hold the entries.
journal.incident.label: Incident
journal.incident.none: No incident selected. Pick one above or create one; every journal entry belongs to an incident, and nothing is read from the radio until one is selected.
journal.incident.createFailed: Could not create the incident: {error}. Nothing was stored; try again.
journal.incident.changeFailed: Could not change the incident: {error}. It is as it was; try again.
journal.incident.closedNotice: This incident is closed. Entries are still recorded in it; reopen it if work continues.
journal.incident.drillHelp: Fixed once created. Every message of a drill goes out as “ØVELSE #n …”, and its journal is kept apart from the real ones.
journal.timeline.title: Timeline
journal.correction.failed: Could not record the correction: {error}. Nothing was stored; try again.
journal.open.title: Open items
journal.open.empty: Nothing open: every outgoing message has a roger.
journal.heard.title: Last heard from
journal.heard.empty: The register is empty. Add radios under Register; a sender the radio hears is added by itself.
journal.heard.help: When each radio was last heard from, over the whole journal, drills included: a message in a drill is real radio contact.
journal.compose.title: New message
journal.add.title: Add by hand
journal.add.failed: Could not add the entry: {error}. Nothing was stored; try again.
journal.entries.empty: Nothing in this incident yet. Send a message (N) or add a note (A) below; what the radio receives lands here by itself.
register.title: Register
register.intro: Which radio belongs to which person, street and role. An entry is never deleted; a radio that is out of service is marked so under Notes.
register.empty: No radios in the register yet. Add one with Add radio, or import the resident list with Import CSV.
register.loadFailed: Could not read the register: {error}. Reload the page; if it persists, the last CSV export holds the list.
register.field.label: Label
register.labelHelp: What the staff call this radio: the person's name, or “radio #7” until it is handed out.
register.publicKeyHelp: The radio's public key: 64 hex characters, typed, pasted or picked from the radio's contact list.
register.publicKeyInvalid: The public key must be exactly 64 hex characters (0–9, a–f).
register.publicKeyTaken: Another register entry already has this public key. Edit that entry instead, or pick another radio.
register.notesHelp: Anything the staff should know, for example “out of service since 12:40”.
register.origin.adhoc: Ad hoc, from the staff's stack
register.savedWithNote: Saved, and noted in the journal.
register.saveFailed: Could not save: {error}. Nothing was stored; try again.
register.picker.title: Contacts on the radio
register.picker.empty: The radio has no contacts yet. Type the key instead, or wait until this radio has heard the field radio.
register.picker.failed: Could not read the contact list: {error}. Is a radio connected? Type the key instead.
register.batch.title: Add several ad hoc radios
register.batch.help: Creates one entry per radio in the stack at the staff, labelled “radio #first” onwards. The name is set at handout by editing the entry.
register.batch.numbersInvalid: Enter whole numbers: first number at least 1, how many between 1 and 100.
register.batch.labelTaken: “{label}” is already in the register. Choose another first number.
register.batch.keyRepeated: This public key is entered twice in the batch.
register.exportFailed: Export failed: {error}. The register is unchanged; try again.
register.pending.title: Not yet bound to a radio
register.pending.help: Imported without a public key. Bind each one to its radio: pick the key from the radio's contact list, or type it.
register.bound: Bound to the radio and added to the register.
register.pendingGone: This row is no longer waiting for a key; the list is reloaded.
register.import.title: Import CSV
register.import.help: A CSV file with the columns label (required), person, street, role, origin (issued, adhoc or private; issued when empty), publicKey and notes, in any order, separated by “;” or “,”. A row without a public key is imported as not yet bound; the key is bound afterwards. Nothing is imported while the file has an error.
register.import.readFailed: Could not read the file: {error}. Pick it again, or save it anew from Excel.
register.import.summary: {file}: {add} to add, {pending} not yet bound to a radio, {errors} errors.
register.import.noRows: The file has no rows under the header line. Check the file and pick it again.
register.import.errors: Errors — nothing is imported until the file is fixed
register.import.imported: Imported {entries} entries and {pending} rows not yet bound from {file}.
register.import.importedWithNote: Imported {entries} entries and {pending} rows not yet bound from {file}, and noted in the journal.
register.import.failed: Import failed: {error}. Nothing was imported; fix the cause and try again.
register.import.notePending: register: imported {count} entries from {file}, {pending} not yet bound to a radio
register.import.error.empty: The file is empty: no header line.
register.import.error.unterminatedQuote: Line {line}: a quoted field is not closed.
register.import.error.badOrigin: Line {line}: origin “{value}” is not issued, adhoc or private.
register.import.error.badKey: Line {line}: public key “{value}” is not 64 hex characters.
register.import.error.duplicateKeyInFile: Line {line}: the same public key is on line {otherLine}.
register.import.error.duplicateKeyInStor: Line {line}: the public key is already in the register, on “{label}”.
printRegister.title: Register
printRegister.count: {count} radios, {pending} not yet bound to a radio
settings.maxSendAttemptsHelp: How many times a radio message is transmitted before the app gives up. Default 3.
settings.maxSendAttemptsInvalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 10.
send.recipient.none: The register is empty. Add radios under Register first.
send.textHelp: Sent as “{prefix}…”. Danish letters count two bytes each.
send.tooLong: Too long: {bytes} bytes, at most {max} including the prefix.
send.dropReply: Drop the link to the incoming message (Esc)
send.noRadio: No radio is connected. Connect one under Radio, or choose another transport.
send.noOperator: Set an operator name under Settings first.
send.composeFailed: Could not record the message: {error}. Nothing was stored; try again.
send.failed: Could not send: {error}. The message is in the journal; retry it from its row.
send.manual.failed: Could not record the status: {error}. Nothing was stored; try again.
send.error.alreadyQueued: This message is already being sent.
send.error.notMesh: Only radio (mesh) messages go through the radio.
send.error.wrongStatus: The message is {status}; only a pending or given-up message can be sent.
send.error.noRecipient: The recipient is not in the register.
settings.sendGapHelp: The least time between two transmissions when sending to all. The mesh tolerates a handful of messages a minute. Default 10.
settings.sendGapInvalid: Enter a whole number of seconds between 1 and 600.
queue.title: Send to all
queue.intro: One text to many radios: one numbered message per recipient, transmitted one at a time with at least {gap} s between them. Watch the queue drain here; every message is in the journal as well.
queue.noIncident: No incident selected. Pick or create one on the journal screen first:
queue.compose.title: Message to many
queue.compose.textHelp: Each recipient gets their own number; the longest among the chosen is “{prefix}”. Danish letters count two bytes each.
queue.compose.noRadio: No radio is connected. Connect one under Radio before sending to all.
queue.compose.partial: Stopped after {stored} of {chosen} messages: {error}. The ones stored are queued.
queue.list.title: Queue
queue.list.empty: Nothing queued in this session. Compose a message to many on the left; the queue shows here as it drains.
queue.list.noRadio: No radio is connected; a batch would wait here until one is.
queue.paused: Paused: no radio connected. The queue goes on when one is connected.
queue.drain: {count} waiting, at least {time} until the last one is transmitted
queue.batch.title: Batch of {time}, {count} recipients
queue.batch.restored: Restored after reload at {time}, {count} still pending
queue.item.label: Radio
queue.error.notInQueue: The message is not in this session's queue.
settings.checkFailed: The check failed: {error}. Probably no internet; the app keeps working as it is.
settings.updatesUnavailable: Updates are checked only in the installed app, opened from its address.
update.available: A new version is available. It is installed when you reload; nothing changes until then.
settings.journalFolderHelp: Every incident, register entry and journal entry is appended to a file in this folder the moment it is written, and every export is saved there too. Pick a folder on a USB stick or in a synced folder: if the laptop dies, the file is still there.
settings.journalFolder.unsupported: This browser cannot write to a folder. Use Chrome or Edge.
settings.journalFolder.file: File: {name}, one line per write, never rewritten. An export file is written when the folder is chosen and on every export.
settings.journalFolder.neverWritten: Nothing written yet in this session.
settings.journalFolder.needsPermission: The browser needs permission to write to the folder again. Reconnect, then allow it.
settings.journalFolder.error: Writing to the folder failed: {error}. Is the folder still there? The lines are kept and written when it is back.
settings.journalFolder.chooseFailed: Could not set the folder: {error}. Try again, or choose another folder.
settings.storage.persisted: The browser has promised to keep this journal.
settings.storage.notPersisted: The browser has not promised to keep this journal and may clear it under storage pressure. Set a journal folder.
print.title: Journal — {incident}
print.drill: ØVELSE / DRILL — the journal of a drill, not of a real incident.
print.noIncident: No incident selected. Pick one on the journal screen first:
print.sinceNever: Not printed before: the whole journal is printed
print.printed: Printed {time}. The next “since last print” starts there.
print.empty: Nothing new since the last print. Untick “Since last print” to print the whole journal.
print.failed: The print time could not be recorded: {error}. The paper is fine; the next “since last print” starts from the previous time.
drill.bandDetail: Drill “{name}”: every outgoing message is sent as “ØVELSE #n …”, and this journal is kept apart from the real ones.
handover.title: Handover
handover.intro: Everything that is open, on one screen, for the operator taking over. Type your name and take over; the handover is noted in the journal.
handover.operator.label: Operator taking over
handover.operator.help: Type the new operator's name and press Take over: the journal gets one note “handover: ‹old› → ‹new›”, and every entry from now on carries the new name.
handover.operator.done: Handed over from {from} to {to}; noted in the journal.
handover.operator.failed: Could not record the handover: {error}. The operator name is unchanged; try again.
handover.open.title: Open orders ({count})
handover.open.help: Outgoing messages without a roger, oldest first.
handover.givenUp.title: Given up ({count})
handover.givenUp.help: Messages the radio gave up on. Decide: retry, send by courier, or close with a reason.
handover.givenUp.courierHelp: Records the same text as a courier message with its own number, and closes this one.
handover.givenUp.courierDone: Sent by courier as #{n}; the radio message is closed.
handover.givenUp.closeHelp: Closes the message as roger, with the reason in the journal.
handover.unanswered.title: Unanswered incoming ({count})
handover.unanswered.help: Incoming messages nobody has replied to, oldest first. A roger is an answer, not a question, and is not listed.
handover.quiet.title: Quiet radios ({count})
handover.quiet.help: Not heard from in more than {minutes} minutes (Settings), the quietest first.
handover.quiet.empty: Every radio has been heard from within {minutes} minutes.
handover.quiet.requestHelp: Sends “#n Meld status” to this radio.
handover.print.title: Handover — {incident}
